config.title: BuddyRelay
config.locale: UI language (auto follows IDE display language; manual switch takes effect after reloading the window)
config.autoCheckin: Enable scheduled daily check-in & credit claiming
config.cockpitEndpoint: Cockpit external environment import source endpoint
config.autoCheckin.randomJitterMinutes: Random check-in jitter window (minutes) to mimic human behavior
config.autoCheckin.perAccountDelaySecond: Max random delay between per-account check-ins (seconds)
config.autoCheckin.startupMakeup: On startup, auto makeup check-ins missed today
config.growthTasks.autoUseMakeupCard: Auto use a makeup card when a streak breaks
config.autoSwitch.on429: Auto switch to a backup account on 429 rate limiting
config.autoSwitch.notifyOnSwitch: Show a toast when auto-switch triggers
config.privacyModeDefault: Start with privacy masking enabled (hide nickname/UID)
config.autoSwitch.quotaThresholdPercent: Auto switch when remaining credits ratio drops to or below this percent
config.autoSwitch.strategy: Candidate account strategy for auto switching
config.autoSwitch.strategy.highest_quota: Prefer accounts with most remaining credits
config.autoSwitch.strategy.health_priori: Prefer accounts with longest check-in streaks
config.growthTasks.autoAfterCheckin: Run growth tasks (accept & claim) automatically after daily check-in
config.update.autoCheck: Silently check GitHub latest release on startup
config.update.autoInstall: Auto download & install new versions without confirmation
config.mainJsPath: Custom CodeBuddy main.js path for hot switching (leave empty for auto-detection; takes effect after reloading the window)
